title: Humility in Daily Life
reading:
Humility is relational. It shows in patience, forgiveness, and gentleness.

To "clothe yourself" with humility suggests intention. It is chosen daily.
reflection: How do I respond when corrected? Is there someone I need to forgive humbly? What does humility look like in my home?
abide: Humility is not reserved for the mountaintop. It is lived in the ordinary — in your home, your words, your silence.
